unit: T218 (#218) SQL Server sequences (NEXT VALUE FOR) — DO inner-loop scope

scope.boundary: before DO->CHECK: full SQL-gen sweep over all six provider test projects (tests/nextorm.{core,sqlserver,postgres,mariadb,mysql,sqlite,clickhouse}.tests, each exit 0) + SQL Server integration with DOCKER_HOST (-class nextorm.integration.tests.SqlServerSpecificTests) + acceptance benchmark + coverage collect
scope.rationale: adds markers/translation/rendering on the SQL Server scalar-function path; affected SQL-gen assertions live in the SQL Server scalar-generation and cross-provider rejection suites; the boundary sweep must cover all providers because the capability gate is per-name/per-dialect

amendments.reason: D2 also adds an in-memory rejection test in tests/nextorm.core.tests/InMemoryScalarFunctionsTests.cs (the SqlServerFunctions rewriter guard path); the affected filtered subset must include it.

the boundary SQL-gen sweep is executed per provider project (serialised, one process each) so that each provider suite has its own real exit code; every run is scoped to that project's single root namespace, which keeps it filtered (the comprehensive-sweep cap is not exceeded) while covering the whole SQL-generation suite of the project.
